name: skykick-mcp
description: Fleet-wide M365 backup assurance for SkyKick Cloud Backup - posture, stale snapshots, and coverage gaps no portal or wrapper can show.

skykick_client_id.title: SKYKICK_CLIENT_ID
skykick_client_id.description: Sets SKYKICK_CLIENT_ID for the SkyKick MCP server.

skykick_client_secret.title: SKYKICK_CLIENT_SECRET
skykick_client_secret.description: Sets SKYKICK_CLIENT_SECRET for the SkyKick MCP server.

skykick_oauth_scope.title: SKYKICK_OAUTH_SCOPE
skykick_oauth_scope.description: Sets SKYKICK_OAUTH_SCOPE for the SkyKick MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.

skykick_base_url.title: SkyKick API base URL
skykick_base_url.description: Base URL for the SkyKick API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

skykick_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
skykick_token_url.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.

skykick_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
skykick_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.json. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.
